g.title: kba_request_execution_sequence
g.text: Generated 2026-07-20 • semantic interpretation first; deterministic gates remain authoritative

g.title: entry
g.text: @KNI CoS • direct agent ask • Slack action • automation

g.title: interpret
g.text: Interpret the goal, preserve wording, and treat an agent mention as routing advice

g.title: uncertainty
g.text: Infer safe defaults → retrieve bounded context → clarify only material ambiguity

g.title: gates
g.text: Approval • record identity • live flags • exact write scope • source sufficiency

g.title: backend
g.text: Bounded single owner or stateful / multi-owner

g.title: direct_owner
g.text: or Chief of Staff delegates one bounded task (KNI Chief of Staff Agent)

g.title: workitem
g.text: SQLite state + selected backend + typed context packs

g.title: direct_tool
g.text: Read / query / scoped write / modify / marked test cleanup

g.title: receipt
g.text: Read-back and exact outcome override speculative completion prose

g.title: context
g.text: Airtable Context Agent • Google Workspace Context Agent • Zotero Context Agent • RSS Context Agent • Preprints Context Agent

g.title: specialists
g.text: Gmail Inbound Triage Agent • Business Research Analyst • Opportunity Scout Agent • Outreach Composer Agent

g.title: checkpoint
g.text: Pause, block, or resume the exact next action

g.title: review
g.text: Check request coverage, blockers, safety, and receipt truth

g.title: render
g.text: Slack / CLI / artifact renderer shows what happened and what remains
